Marcus / team — reviewed attachments from Nova. Finance checklist below (Massachusetts / SaaS reseller scenario):

Required or preferred items to accept as valid resale evidence:
- Clear purchaser name matching our account record (OK).
- Purchaser full business address including street, city, state, ZIP (worksheet shows city/state only; request full street address).
- Purchaser signature and printed name with date (pdf is signed — OK, but date should be visible).
- Statement that items/services purchased are for resale (language present — OK).
- Massachusetts tax registration number or federal EIN on file (MA sometimes accepts EIN; if MA reg is available please include).

Our recommended actions:
1) Ask customer to upload a one-page corrected certificate that includes their full street address and a visible signature date. If they can include MA registration number that speeds approval.
2) If they cannot provide MA reg number immediately, accept interim affidavit on company letterhead signed by an authorized officer plus the worksheet — mark account "pending evidence" and credit future invoices once final docs received.
3) Regarding retrospective credits for INV-3241 & INV-3290: Accounting will consider issuing credit for invoices issued in the current fiscal quarter only; please capture the request formally (we need their signed certificate on file before processing credits).

Please hold any manual tax adjustments in the billing system until we have the final doc. I can approve marking the account exempt for future invoices within 48 business hours of receiving the corrected certificate.

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
